tagline: The Vimeo connector is now available in Lakeflow Connect in Beta.
what_it_does: The Vimeo connector is now available in Lakeflow Connect in Beta. Workspace admins can control access to this feature from the Previews page. The connector ingests team, team member, team role, and audit log data from Vimeo into Databricks.
why_it_matters: Reduces operational overhead and unlocks new capabilities for data teams on Databricks.
plain_summary: The Vimeo connector is now available in Lakeflow Connect in Beta. Workspace admins can control access to this feature from the Previews page.
key_takeaway: The Vimeo connector is now available in Lakeflow Connect in Beta.
